Line numbers come from the four reviews (.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-18-commands/review-A.md to review-D.md) at commit 985f060, with no uncommitted changes in App/lib. Packages run one at a time, in order, and many share files (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart, App/lib/widgets/capture_command_cards.dart, App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart, App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart, App/lib/screens/home_screen.dart, App/lib/screens/verify_email_screen.dart, App/lib/screens/login_screen.dart and the three ARB files): after an earlier package, search for the code a line number points at, and build on what it left.

Every new or changed string goes in app_en.arb, app_es.arb and app_ca.arb (App/docs/LOCALIZATION.md), with an accurate @key description in app_en.arb and typed placeholders; a key a package removes goes from all three. Owner decisions that bind every package (.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-18 later): the voice-commands plan's seven recommendations (nothing is created, changed or deleted before the confirming tap; changes and deletions show before → after and offer «Deshacer»; search includes completed tasks and never answers in sentences; free typing creates tasks only); accounts without Pro create tasks with the form and keep 10 dictations a month; the phone's parser stays only as a dictation's fallback («Guardar tal cual»); new password accounts confirm their email with a 6-digit code.

The speed bar holds for plain capture: a plain one-task dictation stays Añadir tarea → speak → Listo → one confirming tap and looks and saves exactly as today (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:1007 must keep passing). The form and the sign-up are judged by the owner's father: a first-time, non-technical user, in Spanish, often at large text.

Out of scope: Backend/ (no package changes it; server halves are noted for the main session); the owner questions D1–D11 in plan.md; and the three questions already with the owner: deleting one repetition of a repeating task by voice, a default day in the form, and the Android launcher shortcut's wording. Tests: the implementer keeps the whole suite passing and updates only the tests its change rightly breaks (each brief names those it knows); ux-tester writes the acceptance tests and reads copy through the generated AppLocalizations. Harnesses: App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart (`_App.open`, `showResult`, `speak`, `type`; fixtures `command(json)`, `draft(...)`, `serverTask(...)`, projects `physics`, `maths`, `team`; `es`, `ca`; `weekday(date)`), App/test/new_task_form_test.dart (`openForm`, `_App.open`), App/test/project_people_filter_test.dart, App/test/email_verification_test.dart, App/test/auth_gate_test.dart, App/test/capture_free_dictations_test.dart, App/test/capture_landing_test.dart, App/test/project_assignment_test.dart, App/test/delete_account_test.dart.

packages.title: A task that sounds like a command still becomes a task
brief: Context: every dictation, and every typed capture with Pro, now asks the assistant for commands (App/lib/services/capture_processor.dart:229-232). Everyday task titles start with command verbs: «Cambiar la cita del dentista», «Cambia el aceite del coche el sábado», «Busca piso en Valencia», «Buscar a los niños a las 5», «Borrar las fotos del móvil». When one comes back as a change, a deletion or a search that finds nothing, the result offers only «Cerrar» (and «Volver a decirlo» while dictations are left): the thought isn't captured, and a free account has spent a dictation. Shared text, which is someone else's words full of imperatives, is sent the same way with Pro. This package makes such a result end in a task, and stops asking for commands on shares.

UX-901 (S3), part 1, the way out. In `CaptureResult` (voice_task_screen.dart:2130-3449) a result is read-only when `readOnly` (:3229-3230). When it is read-only and every card shown is either a change or a deletion that found nothing (`CommandView.notFound`, capture_command_cards.dart:57-60; this includes a target whose only matches are in projects the person can't edit) or a search with no results (`view.found.isEmpty`), show the existing «Guardar tal cual» (`captureSaveAsWritten`: “Save as written” / «Guardar tal cual» / «Desa-ho tal com està») as the filled button, full width, above «Cerrar» (`_exits(close: true)`, :3415). «Volver a decirlo» stays where it shows today. A search that found tasks, and a change that found its task (for example «Ya está así.»), keep today's footer with no filled button.

UX-901 part 1, what the tap does: exactly what «Guardar tal cual» does after a slow answer (U7, `_saveAsWritten`, :1319-1351). The phone's parser builds the task from the result's words: use the result's `transcript`, falling back to the capture's `text`, because a dictation transcribed online may have no `text`. None of the commands is applied, and the saved capture holds none. The task saves at once (`saveAtOnce`) and lands on Calendar lit, with «Añadida al …» and Deshacer, like any save. Pass this to `CaptureResult` as a callback from the sheet's state, beside `onSayAgain` (:2131-2145); don't write a second parser path, and make sure `CaptureProcessor.asWritten` (capture_processor.dart:56-73) can't fail on an empty `text` here. It sends nothing to the assistant, so a free account spends no second dictation; it is allowed without Pro because it is a dictation's fallback (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-18 later).

UX-901 part 2, completed matches say so. On change and deletion cards (UpdateCommandCard :682-921, DeleteCommandCard :923-992), when the task, or the repetition shown, is completed, add the existing «Completada» (`commandCompleted`: “Completed” / «Completada» / «Completada») as a quiet `_Note` right under the card's first line. On pick-list rows (`_Choice`, :623-645) append it to the day line with « · », as found rows do (:543). Use the same completed rule as `_FoundRow` (:532-533).

UX-904 (S2), shares are tasks. `CaptureStore.acceptEntry` (capture_store.dart:111-146) stores shared text with `source: 'shared'` instead of 'typed'. In `CaptureProcessor._process` (capture_processor.dart:218-233), a shared capture sends `'source': 'typed'` (the server knows only speech and typed) and no `commands`; dictations and words the person typed keep `'commands': true` (decision 7 of the voice-commands plan: typed commands with Pro). Every test of `source == 'speech'` or `!= 'speech'` in voice_task_screen.dart (:535, :667, :1230, :1441, :1473, :1756, :1772, :3239) already treats 'shared' as typed; keep it so. A shared capture keeps 'shared' when its words are edited (:738).

Don't touch: the cards' layout and wording beyond the «Completada» line (P128 and later packages change them); the label «Guardar tal cual» (renaming it waits on D3, UX-919); «Volver a decirlo»; free-dictation counting; Backend/.
acceptance: ES, 1× on 390×844: a dictation answered with one `update` whose target matches no task (transcript «Cambia el aceite del coche el sábado») shows «No encuentro ninguna tarea con «…»» with the command's words, a filled «Guardar tal cual», and «Cerrar» under it.

ES: tapping that «Guardar tal cual» sends no second request to ai/drafts/, saves a task titled «Cambia el aceite del coche» dated next Saturday, closes the sheet, and Calendar shows that Saturday with the row lit and «Añadida al {weekdayDate}» with Deshacer.
ES: a dictation answered with one `find` that finds nothing («Busca piso en Valencia») shows «Guardar tal cual» above «Cerrar»; a `find` that finds two tasks shows no filled button, only «Cerrar».
ES: a result whose `update` found its task but has nothing to change («Ya está así.») shows no «Guardar tal cual».

ES: a deletion card whose matched task is completed shows «Completada» under «Se eliminará: …»; a change card on a completed task shows «Completada» under its title; in a pick list of two matches, the completed one's second line ends with « · Completada».

Unit: a capture accepted through `acceptEntry` is stored with source 'shared'; processing it sends source 'typed' and no `commands` key; a typed capture with Pro sends `commands: true`; a spoken one sends `commands: true`.
ES, free account with 3 dictations left: «Guardar tal cual» on a found-nothing result makes no request to ai/drafts/, and «Te quedan 3 dictados gratis este mes» is unchanged before the sheet closes.
The plain one-task dictation test (App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:1007) passes unchanged.

If two or more do, tell the owner: review A asks to raise UX-901 to severity 4.

packages.title: Command cards say what each tap does
brief: Context: on a deletion card the ✕ means “don't delete”, but TalkBack reads «Quitar Ir al dentista», the deletion's own name; after it the message says «Quitada» and the empty state «No se añadirá nada.», so the task looks deleted and survives. Cancelar asks «¿Quieres conservarlo para más tarde?», where «lo» reads as the task, with a red «Descartar» that is in fact the choice that keeps it. The confirming button says «Aplicar», or keeps «Añadir 1 tarea» when the same tap also changes and deletes. Name the outcome everywhere. Task cards don't change: their ✕ keeps «Quitar {title}» (`removeCaptureItem`, capture_review_editor.dart:537, :561) and their message «Quitada».

UX-903 (S3), the ✕ on command cards: its tooltip, which is also its TalkBack label, replaces `removeCaptureItem` at capture_command_cards.dart:407 and :433 (new project), :719 and :784 (change), :959 and :984 (deletion). New keys, given the title or name each line already passes: `commandDontDelete` “Don’t delete {title}” / «No eliminar {title}» / «No suprimeixis {title}»; `commandDontChange` “Don’t change {title}” / «No cambiar {title}» / «No canviïs {title}»; `commandDontCreate` “Don’t create {name}” / «No crear {name}» / «No creïs {name}».

UX-903, the message after ✕ (`_removeCommand`, voice_task_screen.dart:2623-2633), by the card's kind, replacing `reviewRemoved` there only; Deshacer stays: `commandWontDelete` “Won’t be deleted” / «No se eliminará» / «No es suprimirà»; `commandWontChange` “Won’t be changed” / «No se cambiará» / «No es canviarà»; `commandWontCreate` “Won’t be created” / «No se creará» / «No es crearà». `_remove` (task cards, :2571-2586) keeps «Quitada».

UX-903, `captureRemovedDraftsHelp` (the empty state once every card is removed, :3360-3364): “Nothing will change.” / «No se hará ningún cambio.» / «No es farà cap canvi.». It is true for removed tasks too.

UX-903, the keep question (`_askToKeep`, :251-272, used while listening, while typing and on a result). Settled with the 2026-10-14 fix (UX-605, UX-612) that made one question cover typed words: name the words, spoken or written. Spoken words (listening; a result whose capture is speech or has audio, `spoken` at :3239): `captureKeepQuestion` becomes “Keep what you said for later?” / «¿Conservar lo que has dicho para más tarde?» / «Vols conservar el que has dit per a més tard?». Typed or shared words (typing in the sheet; any other result): new `captureKeepTextQuestion` “Keep the text for later?” / «¿Conservar el texto para más tarde?» / «Vols conservar el text per a més tard?» (the organizer's copy, from the «Ver lo que dije» / «Texto original» split). The buttons stay Descartar / Conservar. Whether Cancel should ask at all on a result with no task to add waits on D1 (UX-917): don't change when the question shows.

UX-905 (S2), the confirming button (label at :3250-3267). Sort what the tap does into three kinds: add (ready tasks, `ready > 0`), change (`changes > 0`), delete (`deletes > 0`). New projects are named only when they are all the tap does. Add only: today's add labels (`captureAddTasks` / `captureAddToCalendar` / `captureAddTask`), with or without their new project. Change only: exactly one change whose only field is the planned day or time (the `onlyMoved` rule in `_apply`, :2882-2890) reads the existing `reschedule` “Reschedule” / «Cambiar fecha» / «Canvia la data»; any other change, or several, read the existing `saveChangesSentence` “Save changes” / «Guardar cambios» / «Desa els canvis». Delete only, even when a new project is created too: «Eliminar» (`delete`) with today's red style and delete icon (:3383-3398), so `deleteOnly` also holds when projects are created (settled by the organizer: the label names only the deletion, so it keeps the warning colour). Projects only: `commandCreateProjects`, as today.

UX-905, mixes, new keys: `commandAddAndChange` “Add and change” / «Añadir y cambiar» / «Afegeix i canvia»; `commandAddAndDelete` “Add and delete” / «Añadir y eliminar» / «Afegeix i suprimeix»; `commandChangeAndDelete` “Change and delete” / «Cambiar y eliminar» / «Canvia i suprimeix»; `commandAddChangeAndDelete` “Add, change and delete” / «Añadir, cambiar y eliminar» / «Afegeix, canvia i suprimeix». «Terminar», «Revisa los datos de arriba» and «Guardando…» stay as they are. Remove `commandApply` from the three catalogs. `saveChanges` (English “Save Changes”, title case; review A's cross-slice note) is used nowhere in lib/: delete it from the three catalogs too.

Existing tests that change for the right reason: App/test/voice_command_cards_test.dart:513 and :529 (one change of day only now reads «Cambiar fecha», `reschedule`, instead of `commandApply`), :943 (a task, a change and a deletion now read «Añadir, cambiar y eliminar») and :1255 (the 2× case, in ES and CA, reads `commandAddChangeAndDelete` instead of `captureAddTasks(1)` and `(2)`), and any other test that reads `commandApply`, `reviewRemoved` after a command's ✕, `captureRemovedDraftsHelp` or `captureKeepQuestion`.
Don't touch: task cards' ✕ and messages; when the keep question shows (waits on D1); the buttons' order; the label «Guardar tal cual» (waits on D3).
acceptance: ES, semantics: the deletion card's ✕ has the tooltip and label «No eliminar Dentista»; a change card's «No cambiar Ir al médico»; the new-project card's «No crear Física»; a task card's ✕ still reads «Quitar Comprar pan».

ES: with every card removed, the result shows «No queda nada por revisar» and «No se hará ningún cambio.», and the button reads «Terminar».

ES: Cancelar on a spoken result holding a deletion card asks «¿Conservar lo que has dicho para más tarde?» with Descartar and Conservar; Cancelar while listening with words asks the same; Cancelar while typing with Pro, and on a typed result, asks «¿Conservar el texto para más tarde?».

ES, the confirming button: one change of day only reads «Cambiar fecha»; one change of title reads «Guardar cambios»; two changes read «Guardar cambios»; a task and a change read «Añadir y cambiar»; a task and a deletion «Añadir y eliminar»; a change and a deletion «Cambiar y eliminar»; a task, a change and a deletion «Añadir, cambiar y eliminar»; a deletion alone reads «Eliminar» on the error colour; a new project alone «Crear proyecto»; a task into a new project «Añadir tarea» or «Añadir al calendario», as today.
CA at 2× on 320×640 with Manrope: «Afegeix, canvia i suprimeix» takes at most 2 lines inside the button, and nothing overflows.

packages.title: Deadline-only tasks show and land on their due day; a project made by voice opens
brief: Context: the plan's own example, «Crea un proyecto de matemáticas y añade terminar la presentación para el 12», returns a task with only a deadline. The project card makes the result compact, so the task's card shows only «Sin fecha» (`_dateLine(main: false)`, capture_review_editor.dart:774, through `taskDayLine`); after the tap the message says «Proyecto creado · Añadida sin fecha» and Calendar lights the Sin fecha row, though Calendar also lists the task on the 12th (`Task.calendarOccurrencesOn`). The same happens to any deadline task in a dictation of several, including the owner's 2026-10-15 example (“…by Thursday at 5”). And a project made by voice is never shown: «Proyecto creado» closes onto Calendar, while making one by hand opens its page (UX-327, `createProject`, task_lists_screen.dart:416-428).

UX-902 (S3), what shows. Where a line shows only a task's day, and the task has no day but a deadline, show `taskDeadlineLabel` (task_planning_control.dart:7-13: “Due Thu, 12 Nov” / «Vence jue, 12 nov» / «Termini: dj., 12 de nov.») with `Icons.flag_outlined` instead of «Sin fecha» with the calendar icon, in: the collapsed card's date line (`_dateLine`, capture_review_editor.dart:372-401, via :774; TalkBack reads the same text, and it still opens the date sheet); pick-list rows (`_Choice`, capture_command_cards.dart:636-641); and found rows (`_FoundRow`, :535-539), which today show the deadline's date bare, as if it were the day. The opened card (`main: true`, :598) keeps «Sin fecha» with its deadline row under it. Don't change `taskDayLine` itself (task_schedule_label.dart:8-13): Calendar, Tareas and the form use it.

UX-902, where it lands. In `_save` (voice_task_screen.dart:2433-2483) and `_apply` (:2867-2936), a task with no day but a deadline lands on its deadline's day: count `Task.day(deadline)` among `days`, and count the task as undated (`undated:`) only when it has neither a day nor a deadline. Calendar already lists such a task on that day, so its row lights there and the Sin fecha row doesn't.

UX-902, the message. For one saved task with no day but a deadline, new key `taskAddedDue` replaces `taskSavedInbox` (in `_save`'s `added`, :2444-2448, and in `_apply`'s parts, :2895-2900): “Added · due {date}” / «Añadida · vence el {date}» / «Afegida · venç el {date}», with `{date}` = `context.weekdayDate(deadline)`. Several tasks keep `captureTasksAdded` and `captureAlsoOn` / `captureAlsoOnDays`, with deadline days counted as the tasks' days.

UX-906 (S2). In `_apply`, when the sheet closes (nothing left pending), the tap created exactly one project (`applied.projects.length == 1`), every task it added went into that project (or it added none), and it changed no task (`applied.updates.isEmpty`; deletions don't matter, since they land nowhere): open that project's page, `HomeScreen(isRoot: false, listId: id)`, as `createProject` does, and light its new tasks there as a project page lights a landing (`_land` / `_landingIds`, home_screen.dart:132-171, :495-501). The page doesn't exist before the push, so give HomeScreen a way to start with that landing (for example an optional set of task ids it lands on first build); no visible control. The message (`parts`, :2892-2914) shows there, with Deshacer. Every other result lands on Calendar as now.

UX-906, Deshacer. It already takes the project and its tasks back and reopens the result (:2943-3034). With the project's page open, close that page first (the project is gone), then reopen the result over the screen underneath, as today.

How the two fit: the plan's example (one new project, one deadline-only task in it) opens the Matemáticas page with the row lit and «Proyecto creado · Añadida · vence el jue, 12 nov». A deadline-only task that doesn't go into a single new project lands on Calendar on the deadline's day.
Don't touch: the opened card's date line; the form; `taskDayLine`; U5's landing for tasks with a day; the find card's other lines (P137 changes its rows' icon and heading). No new controls.
acceptance: ES, 1×: a result with a `project` command «Matemáticas» and a draft «Terminar la presentación» into it with only a deadline 5 days ahead shows, on the collapsed task card, «Vence {weekdayDate}» with the flag icon and no «Sin fecha» line; opened, the card shows «Sin fecha» as its main line and the deadline row under it.
ES: a pick-list row and a found row for a task with only a deadline show «Vence {weekdayDate}», not the bare date.

ES: a plain dictation of one task with only a deadline 3 days ahead: after «Añadir tarea», Calendar selects that day, the task's row is lit, the Sin fecha row is not lit, and the message reads «Añadida · vence el {weekdayDate}» with Deshacer.

ES: a dictation of two tasks, one for tomorrow and one with only a deadline 3 days ahead: Calendar lands on tomorrow with that row lit, and the message names the other day («2 tareas añadidas · También el {weekdayDate}»).

ES: «Nuevo proyecto: Física» alone: after «Crear proyecto», the Física project page is on top (app bar «Física») and «Proyecto creado» shows with Deshacer; after Deshacer, no project Física exists, its page has closed, and the result shows again.
ES: «Nuevo proyecto: Física» with «Estudiar el tema 2» into it: after the tap, the Física page shows «Estudiar el tema 2» lit.

ES: the plan's example (project «Matemáticas» and the deadline-only «Terminar la presentación» into it): the Matemáticas page opens with the row lit and «Proyecto creado · Añadida · vence el {weekdayDate}».
ES: a result that creates a project and also changes a task lands on Calendar on the changed task's day, as today.
deviceChecks: Phone, real model, in Spanish: «Crea un proyecto de matemáticas y añade terminar la presentación para el 12» opens the Matemáticas page with the task lit and the due day in the message.

packages.title: A task for someone else lands in view on Calendar and Tareas
brief: Context: once an account has a shared project, Calendar's and Tareas' filter defaults to «Para mí» (`ProjectScope.team = false`, App/lib/providers/project_scope_provider.dart:7). A task made for Ana (the form: Más detalles › Familia › Ana; or a dictation «Ana tiene que…») isn't «for me» (App/lib/models/task.dart:59-63; `taskInProjectScope`, project_scope_provider.dart:18-32). On save, Calendar selects the day and shows the message, but the row is filtered out: nothing lights and nothing scrolls. The Tareas root behaves the same. Project pages already clear «Para mí» and the person for a landing (home_screen.dart:132-171); Calendar's `_land` (calendar_screen.dart:119-134) and the Tareas root's don't. The severity scale's own blocker example is a saved task the person can't see, so they add it twice.

UX-1001 (S3), Calendar: in `_land`, when the app-wide scope (`projectScopeProvider`) hides any landed task, widen it before selecting the day: first to «Todas» (`team: true`, keeping the project), and if the project filter still hides it, to all projects (`projectId: null`, shown as the existing `projectsAll`: “All projects” / «Todos los proyectos» / «Tots els projectes»). Then select the day and light the row as now. A landing the scope already shows changes nothing.

UX-1001, the Tareas root: in `HomeScreen._land` (:132-171), when `widget.listId == null` and the page's own search, label and chip aren't what hides the task, widen the app-wide scope the same way (Todas, then all projects). Project pages keep their own rule.
This covers capture results, the form and voice assignments alike, because they all land through `CalendarFocus`. No copy change and no new control.
Don't touch: which project a new task goes to when Calendar is filtered (an older owner question, UX-302); the person filter on project pages; the scope's default.
acceptance: ES, 1×: an account (id 1) in a shared project «Familia» with Ana (id 2) as editor, Calendar on its default «Para mí». A free account opens Nueva tarea, types «Llamar al médico», taps Mañana, chooses Familia and the person «Ana» under Más detalles, and taps «Añadir al calendario». Calendar shows Mañana selected, «Todas» selected, the row «Llamar al médico» lit, and «Añadida al {weekdayDate}» with Deshacer.
ES: the same saved from the Tareas root (default «Para mí»): afterwards «Todas» is selected and the row is lit.
ES, Pro: a capture result assigned to Ana and saved from Calendar under «Para mí»: «Todas» is selected and the row is lit.
ES: Calendar's project filter on «Casa», and a task for the account itself saved into «Familia»: afterwards the project filter shows «Todos los proyectos» and the row is lit.
ES: a task for the account itself saved under «Para mí» leaves «Para mí» selected.
deviceChecks: Phone, Pro, a project shared with a second account: on Calendar say «Ana tiene que llamar al médico mañana» and save; Mañana shows the row lit, with «Todas» selected.

packages.title: A shared project's people filter: every chip in view, one order, named for TalkBack
brief: Context: on a shared project's page with two or more other editors, `_PeopleFilter` (project_scope_control.dart:217-275) shows «Todas · Para mí · Ana · Paul…» in one row that scrolls sideways and is clipped by the page's 24 dp padding (home_screen.dart:329). When a gap falls at the clip, the row looks complete: at 2× on 393 dp, or at 1.3× with «Ana García», Paul is entirely off-screen, and at 2× on 320 dp only Todas and Para mí show. Real names are often email prefixes, the widest labels (UX-1102). Elsewhere (Calendar, Tareas, a shared project nobody else edits) the pair reads «Para mí · Todas» (:199-210), the other way round. packages.title: Sign-in errors name the problem: a wrong password, and how long to wait
brief: Context, UX-402 (reopened): the real server answers a wrong password, or an address with no account, with 401 and the detail «Email or password is incorrect.» (Backend/core/auth_views.py:173). `requestProblem` (request_locale.dart:80-82) recognises only simplejwt's wording, so the 401 falls to `session` (:95) and sign-in says «Vuelve a iniciar sesión para continuar. Tus tareas locales se conservan.», without «Crear una cuenta con este correo» (UX-402) or «¿Has olvidado tu contraseña?» (UX-488). The app's tests pass only because they fake simplejwt's text (auth_gate_test.dart:277, :600, :727). Context, UX-1208: every 429 on the auth screens says «Demasiadas solicitudes. Espera un poco antes de volver a intentarlo.» (`rateLimit`), though the server sends the wait (Retry-After 900 for sign-in's 15-minute lock, auth_views.py:166-167; read into `ApiException.retryAfter`, api_client.dart:536-546).

UX-402 (S3): classify by status and endpoint, not by English text. In `ApiClient.signIn` (api_client.dart:210-243), a 401 from `auth/login/` (not register) means wrong credentials, whatever its wording: rethrow it as an `ApiException` that carries a marker of the app's own, keeping status, message and retryAfter, and make `requestProblem` (request_locale.dart:78-97) read that marker first, before its text rules and its generic 401 → `session` rule (:95). Use a field, or a body key, that no other rule reads: a body `email` key already means `email` (:79), and a 400 with a body `code` key means `recoveryCode` (:90). Keep the simplejwt matches for older servers. The copy stays (`requestError` credentials: «No encontramos esa cuenta o la contraseña no es correcta.»), and `unknownAccount` (login_screen.dart:320-325) then offers «Crear una cuenta con este correo», or after «Iniciar sesión con este correo» the recovery button (UX-488).

UX-1208 (S1), the wait: in whole minutes rounded up, at least 1, from `retryAfter` or else DRF's English ending, as the delete page's `_waitMinutesFor` does (delete_account_screen.dart:178-191). Move that helper beside `requestProblem` in request_locale.dart, and rename the key `deleteAccountThrottledWait` to a shared `tooManyTriesWait`, its text unchanged: “{minutes, plural, =1{Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.} other{Too many tries. Wait {minutes} minutes and try again.}}” / «{minutes, plural, =1{Demasiados intentos. Espera un minuto y vuelve a intentarlo.} other{Demasiados intentos. Espera {minutes} minutos y vuelve a intentarlo.}}» / «{minutes, plural, =1{Massa intents. Espera un minut i torna-ho a provar.} other{Massa intents. Espera {minutes} minuts i torna-ho a provar.}}». The delete page uses the moved helper and the renamed key, unchanged for the person.

UX-1208, where: in `requestProblemText` called with `onSignIn: true` (the auth screens: verify_email_screen.dart:119 and login_screen.dart's `problem`), a `rateLimit` answer whose wait is known shows `tooManyTriesWait(minutes)`; without a known wait `rateLimit` stays. That covers the confirm screen, «Crea tu cuenta» and sign-in. Other screens keep today's line.

Tests: those that fake simplejwt's wording keep passing; ux-tester adds the server's real answer. Update the tests that read `deleteAccountThrottledWait` (App/test/delete_account_test.dart) to the new key.
Don't touch: the server; sign-in's password rules; other 401s (a session that ended elsewhere still reads `session`).

packages.title: Confirm your email: the answer in view, the keyboard steady, an honest «expired»
brief: Context, App/lib/screens/verify_email_screen.dart: on the 6th digit the field turns read-only (:312), which closes Android's keyboard; on a refusal it comes back and covers the message, and nothing scrolls the answer into view (sign-in does, `_reveal`, login_screen.dart:128-158). The field is autofocused (:308), so on arrival the keyboard also hides «Reenviar código» and «Usar otro correo», the way out for someone who still has to fetch the code. The server answers `code_expired` both for a spent code and for an address already confirmed (Backend/core/auth_views.py:118-122), for example after the right code's answer was lost, and resend then sends nothing. Confirmar and the keyboard's ✓ resend refused digits, spending tries (5 lock the code). «Pide uno nuevo» names an action the screen calls «Reenviar código», and on `code_expired` the countdown is cancelled (:196-199), inviting a resend the server drops within the minute.

At least 60 s since `_sentAt`: that sign-in sent a new code, so empty and focus the field, set `_sentAt` to now and restart the countdown, as after Reenviar, and show new `verifyEmailCodeSpentNew` “That code no longer works. We’ve sent you a new one.” / «Ese código ya no sirve. Te hemos enviado uno nuevo.» / «Aquest codi ja no serveix. T’hem enviat un codi nou.». Within the 60 s: keep the countdown running, and show new `verifyEmailCodeSpentWait` “That code no longer works. Tap “Resend code” when the countdown ends.” / «Ese código ya no sirve. Toca «Reenviar código» cuando acabe la cuenta atrás.» / «Aquest codi ja no serveix. packages.title: Confirm your email survives the trip to the inbox
brief: Context: the password lives only in memory (verify_email_screen.dart:30-38), the screen is a plain pushed route (login_screen.dart:184-207), and a cold start without a session opens a blank sign-in (main.dart:427-431). If Android kills TaskFlow while the person reads the email (a low-memory phone, or «Cerrar todo» in recent apps), they come back to «Inicia sesión», must retype the 12-character password they invented a minute ago, and signing in or creating the account again emails a new code that replaces the one they just read.

UX-1202 (S3): remember the pending address, never the password. Keep it from the moment «Confirma tu correo» opens until the address is confirmed, «Usar otro correo» is tapped, or 30 minutes pass (the code's life). Store only the address and when it was saved, in the kind of storage a pending invitation uses (App/lib/services/invitation_links.dart: FlutterSecureStorage, injectable for tests), behind a provider tests can replace. The file name above is a suggestion.

On a cold start with no session and a pending address younger than 30 minutes, open «Confirma tu correo» for it straight away, over sign-in, without a password: its own password field already exists for this case (`widget.password == null`, verify_email_screen.dart:354-383; tested at App/test/email_verification_test.dart:727). Send nothing on the way (no sign-in, no resend), so the code in the inbox still works. Not when sign-in is the session-expiry screen (`signInAgain`). An older entry is dropped.

In that case (the screen asks for the password itself), a `signup_replaced` answer most likely means a mistyped password, since verify checks the password first (Backend/docs/EMAIL_VERIFICATION.md:39): stay on the screen and show new `verifyEmailWrongPassword` under the password field: “That isn’t this account’s password.” / «Esa contraseña no es la de esta cuenta.» / «Aquesta contrasenya no és la d’aquest compte.». The same line shows there when P133's sign-in check answers wrong credentials. After sign-up or sign-in (password passed in), `signup_replaced` keeps today's return to «Crea tu cuenta».
Back keeps the pending address (the person may come back for it); «Usar otro correo» and a confirmed address clear it.
Don't touch: the server; what the screen asks when it opens from sign-up or sign-in. The password is never written anywhere.
acceptance: ES: open the confirm screen after a sign-up, then rebuild the app as a cold start with the same storage and no session: «Confirma tu correo» opens for that address with the password field, and no request was sent.
ES: the same after the clock moves 31 minutes, after «Usar otro correo», or after the address was confirmed: the cold start opens plain sign-in.

decisions.question: Cancel on a result with nothing to add: should Cancelar just close, meaning “don't do it”?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. When a result only changes, deletes or creates projects, Cancelar, Back and the dimmed area close at once and discard it. Today they ask keep-or-discard, as U2 does for spoken words, and «Conservar» leaves a pending deletion in «Sin guardar». The words can be said again, at the cost of a free dictation on a free account. Results with a task to add keep asking. P128 rewords the question meanwhile.

decisions.question: Date words in the form's title: should the phone's parser fill in the day and time?
decisions.recommendation: For words dictated before «Escribir», yes: they are a dictation, and «Guardar tal cual» already reads them on the phone; today «Médico el viernes a las 5» becomes a title with no day, and Back saves it that way (D12). For titles typed in the form, no: your 2026-10-18 decision keeps a free account's typing literal, and the first-run line teaches the day chips. Review B's case («Médico el viernes» typed, saved to Sin fecha) belongs with your open question about a default day in the form.

decisions.question: Rename «Guardar tal cual» to «Guardar como tarea» / “Save as a task” / «Desa-ho com a tasca»?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. A dictation can now be a command. After 8 s «Guardar tal cual» is the filled button, so «Borra la tarea del dentista» is easily saved as a new task, and P127 shows it on command results that find nothing. The new name says what the tap makes. It changes D3 and U7's wording, so it's yours.

decisions.question: Should a search by period («¿qué tengo esta semana?») list by day instead of newest first?
decisions.recommendation: Yes, for a search with a period: by day and time, soonest first, which is how the question is meant. Other searches stay newest first, as the approved plan's item 5 says. P137 already shows the period under the heading.

decisions.question: At 0 free dictations, should the creation button keep «Añadir tarea» (with the + icon) instead of becoming «Nueva tarea»?
decisions.recommendation: Keep «Nueva tarea». You asked for the button to change once the dictations run out, and it shares its name with the form's page (review B keeps it). Review A would keep «Añadir tarea», because renaming the one main button each month costs recognition; if you agree with A, `tasksEmptyForm` and `inboxEmptyForm` change too.

decisions.question: Back on a new task in the form: show the button's message instead of «Cambios guardados»?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. Keep D12's saving, but for a new task Back says what the button says («Añadida al lun, 19 oct» or «Añadida sin fecha», with Deshacer). A newcomer who presses Back to get out hears about changes he didn't make, and isn't told the day. It changes D12's wording, so it's yours.

decisions.question: When a task is added on a shared project's page while a person's chip is on, should it be that person's task by default?
decisions.recommendation: Yes, as a picked day already is (D9) and as the page already sets the project. Today it goes to «Todos», and the page switches back to Todas to show it. The person shows on the form and the card, and changes with one tap.

decisions.question: How should people get a real name instead of the first part of their email?
decisions.recommendation: Google accounts (the first sign-in option): take the name from Google at sign-in, falling back to the email; that is a server change for the main session (Backend/core/google_auth.py:77 stores none), not a product question. Password accounts: ask once when they first share or join a shared project, prefilled from the email and skippable, rather than one more field at sign-up. Until then, chips, «Creada por» and the person picker read «ana.garcia84», «paulsmith».

decisions.question: Should «Reenviar código» admit when no code was sent?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. When this address's own limit blocks a code (5 codes an hour, 8 emails a day), the server answers 429 with Retry-After, and the app says «Has pedido muchos códigos. Espera {n} minutos para pedir otro.» and keeps Reenviar off. It tells someone pressing resend that an unconfirmed sign-up exists for that address, which is worth little: they typed it. Server first (main session), then the app half in a later run.

decisions.question: Add an «Abrir el correo» button to «Confirma tu correo»?
decisions.recommendation: Not now. It adds a control, and the code is in the email's subject, so the phone's notification already shows it. Watch for it in the §7 test with an email sign-up rather than Google.

decisions.question: Does asking for commands on every dictation slow down plain capture?
decisions.recommendation: Measure before deciding (main session, staging, same phone and network): 10 or more one-task dictations with the commands flag and 10 or more without it, reading extraction_ms p50 and p95 in Diagnóstico de captura. If the flag adds 300 ms or more at p50, the cause is the longer prompt on the server: decide it with UX-616 (a shorter commands section, a faster model, or the paid fallback). Speed is the selling point, so it's worth the half hour.
